agents.name: Route & Transport Planner Agent
agents.description: Suggests fastest, cheapest, or most convenient routes. Adjusts routes dynamically based on traffic or disruptions. Provides travel time estimates and alternative routes.

agents.name: Local Services & Safety Agent
agents.description: Recommends nearby restaurants, hospitals, ATMs, police stations. Sends safety alerts about hazards, weather changes, or strikes. Provides emergency contact info.

agents.name: Itinerary & Expense Tracker Agent
agents.description: Tracks bookings, manages itinerary, monitors expenses. Creates daily schedules, budget summaries, and reminders. Notifies if activities overlap or expenses exceed budget.

agents.name: Trip Manager Agent
agents.description: Creates and manages group trips. Handles participant addition/removal, trip details (name, destination, dates). Tracks active participants.

agents.name: Expense Tracker Agent
agents.description: Records individual expenses with payer, amount, category, and split type. Tracks who paid what and who shares each expense. Validates expense entries.

agents.name: Settlement Calculator Agent
agents.description: Computes real-time balances, per-person shares, and optimal settlements. Calculates who owes whom and by how much. Minimizes number of transactions needed.

agents.name: Trip Summary Agent
agents.description: Generates comprehensive trip reports with total expenses, category-wise breakdown, per-person spending, and settlement suggestions. Creates shareable summaries.
